Fabrication outputs for HDI
Generated by Waffle 1.0 on 2026-11-18T10:30:00+00:00

Coordinates: lower-left corner of the board outline, viewed from the top, Y up.
Pick and place rotation: degrees counter-clockwise viewed from the top, for both sides (Altium's convention). Bottom-side parts are mirrored about their Y axis; in IPC-7351B's bottom-view convention a bottom part's rotation is (360 - value) mod 360. X is always the top-view X.
Gerber: RS-274X with X2 attributes, millimetres, format 4:6, leading zeros omitted, absolute.
Drill: Excellon, metric, decimal-point coordinates.
Solder mask and paste expansion: per pad from the design rules and pad overrides. Vias tented unless the via sets its own tenting or IPC-4761 type.
Copper layers (top to bottom): Top Layer, Mid-Layer 1, Mid-Layer 2, Mid-Layer 3, Mid-Layer 4, Mid-Layer 5, Mid-Layer 6, Bottom Layer.
Copper pours: none.

HDI and via construction:
  - Construction: 2+4+2 sequential build-up, 8 copper layers, 3 laminations: core L3-L6, then L2-L7, then L1-L8.
  - Microvias: laser drilled, stacked microvias copper filled; skip vias allowed.
  - Drill span L1-L2 (Top - Inner 1): 5 laser microvias, drill 0.1 mm, IPC-4761 Type VII x5, drilled after build-up step 2.
  - Drill span L2-L3 (Inner 1 - Inner 2): 4 laser microvias, drill 0.1 mm, IPC-4761 Type VII x4, drilled after build-up step 1.
  - Drill span L3-L6 (Inner 2 - Inner 5): 1 buried via, drill 0.3 mm, drilled in the core.
  - Drill span L6-L7 (Inner 5 - Inner 6): 1 laser microvia, drill 0.1 mm, IPC-4761 Type VII x1, drilled after build-up step 1.
  - Drill span L7-L8 (Inner 6 - Bottom): 1 laser microvia, drill 0.1 mm, IPC-4761 Type VII x1, drilled after build-up step 2.
  - Stacked microvias: 2 sites, up to 2 high; fill every microvia below another with copper.
  - Via-in-pad: 2 vias in SMD pads; fill (IPC-4761 Type VII: filled, planarised and plated over) before final plating. 1 is not filled.
  - Via protection (IPC-4761): Type VII (Filled and capped) x11.
  - Back-drill: 1 via from the bottom, keep L3 Inner 2 connected, max stub 0.15 mm.

Notes:
  - Microvias are listed in separate laser-drill (-Microvia) files. (11 instances)
  - Plugged or filled vias (IPC-4761) are tagged with their type in the drill files. (11 instances)
  - Blind or buried vias are drilled from separate layer-pair files.
  - Back-drilled vias are listed in separate -BackDrill files with their stop layer and maximum stub.
